verification.stimulus: Validate the candidate protocol against its v2 schema and semantic closure, recompute the canonical authoring semantic digest, and inspect the phase definition surface.
verification.expectedSemanticState: Protocol 2.x contains only phase and runtime machines, binds the separate authoring authority by exact semantic digest, and contains no T42 through T46 definition.
verification.expectedEvidenceState: node:test reports the literal assertion: candidate protocol 2.x binds the exact canonical authoring-protocol digest and retires T42 through T46
